title: iPerf Dashboard (Public)
description: A ↔ B connectivity: iperf3 throughput, ping latency/jitter/loss, ttl traceroute with ECMP discovery.

list.name: client
list.label: A (client)
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT h.id || '___' || COALESCE(h.alias, h.host)
FROM iperf_hosts h
WHERE h.id IN (SELECT run_on_host_id FROM iperf_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
               UNION SELECT run_on_host_id FROM iperf_traces WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days')
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT h.id || '___' || COALESCE(h.alias, h.host)
FROM iperf_hosts h
WHERE h.id IN (SELECT run_on_host_id FROM iperf_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
               UNION SELECT run_on_host_id FROM iperf_traces WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days')
list.description: Host that ran the test (one per WAN). Pick several to compare them against the same peer.

list.name: peer
list.label: B (peer)
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT h.id || '___' || COALESCE(h.alias, h.host)
FROM iperf_hosts h
WHERE h.id IN (
  SELECT peer_host_id FROM iperf_logs
  WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND ('0' IN ($client) OR run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  UNION
  SELECT peer_host_id FROM iperf_traces
  WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND ('0' IN ($client) OR run_on_host_id IN ($client)))
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT h.id || '___' || COALESCE(h.alias, h.host)
FROM iperf_hosts h
WHERE h.id IN (
  SELECT peer_host_id FROM iperf_logs
  WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND ('0' IN ($client) OR run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  UNION
  SELECT peer_host_id FROM iperf_traces
  WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND ('0' IN ($client) OR run_on_host_id IN ($client)))
list.description: The other end: iperf3 server / ping target.

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Trace
list.definition:
SELECT t.id AS __value,
  t.id || ' · ' || to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' UTC · ' || COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS __text
FROM iperf_traces t
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY t.id DESC
LIMIT 100
list.query:
SELECT t.id AS __value,
  t.id || ' · ' || to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' UTC · ' || COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS __text
FROM iperf_traces t
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY t.id DESC
LIMIT 100
list.description: Defaults to the latest trace of the selection.

list.name: test_id
list.label: Test
list.definition:
SELECT l.id AS __value,
  l.id || ' · ' || to_char(l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' UTC · ' || COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host)
    || CASE l.test_type WHEN 'download' THEN ' ↓' ELSE ' ↑' END AS __text
FROM iperf_logs l
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at) AND l.test_type <> 'icmp' AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY l.id DESC
LIMIT 100
list.query:
SELECT l.id AS __value,
  l.id || ' · ' || to_char(l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' UTC · ' || COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host)
    || CASE l.test_type WHEN 'download' THEN ' ↓' ELSE ' ↑' END AS __text
FROM iperf_logs l
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at) AND l.test_type <> 'icmp' AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY l.id DESC
LIMIT 100
list.description: Per-second speed of one test (Raw results row).

panels.title: Pairs (A ↔ B) — selected range
panels.description:
One row per client (A, the host running the test — one per WAN) and peer (B).
p10 = speed you get 90 % of the time. Bloat = loaded − idle RTT (median). Loss trace = ICMP loss at the destination from ttl. Routes = distinct router paths seen. ECMP = most routers answering a single hop. Click A or B to focus the dashboard on that pair.

targets.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT l.* FROM iperf_logs l
  WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at)
  AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
), s AS (
  SELECT run_on_host_id AS c_id, peer_host_id AS p_id,
    max(created_at) AS last_seen,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE test_type <> 'icmp') AS tests,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY average_speed) FILTER (WHERE test_type = 'download') AS down_p50,
    percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY average_speed) FILTER (WHERE test_type = 'download') AS down_p10,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY average_speed) FILTER (WHERE test_type = 'upload') AS up_p50,
    percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY average_speed) FILTER (WHERE test_type = 'upload') AS up_p10,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (latency_idle->>'avg_ms')::numeric)
      FILTER (WHERE test_type IN ('download', 'icmp')) AS idle_rtt,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (latency_loaded->>'avg_ms')::numeric - (latency_idle->>'avg_ms')::numeric)
      FILTER (WHERE test_type = 'download') AS bloat_down,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (latency_loaded->>'avg_ms')::numeric - (latency_idle->>'avg_ms')::numeric)
      FILTER (WHERE test_type = 'upload') AS bloat_up,
    avg((latency_idle->>'jitter_ms')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE test_type IN ('download', 'icmp')) AS idle_jitter,
    avg((latency_idle->>'loss_pct')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE test_type IN ('download', 'icmp')) AS idle_loss,
    avg((latency_loaded->>'loss_pct')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE test_type IN ('download', 'upload')) AS loaded_loss
  FROM l GROUP BY 1, 2
), t AS (
  SELECT t.run_on_host_id AS c_id, t.peer_host_id AS p_id,
    max(t.id) AS last_trace,
    (array_agg(t.hop_count ORDER BY t.created_at DESC))[1] AS hops,
    (array_agg(t.asn_path ORDER BY t.created_at DESC))[1] AS asn_path,
    count(DISTINCT t.path_hash) AS routes,
    max(t.ecmp_max_width) AS ecmp_width,
    avg(t.dest_loss_pct) AS trace_loss
  FROM iperf_traces t
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
  AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) AS "A (client)",
  COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS "B (peer)",
  s.down_p50 AS "↓ p50", s.down_p10 AS "↓ p10",
  s.up_p50 AS "↑ p50", s.up_p10 AS "↑ p10",
  s.idle_rtt AS "RTT idle",
  s.bloat_down AS "Bloat ↓", s.bloat_up AS "Bloat ↑",
  s.idle_jitter AS "Jitter",
  s.idle_loss AS "Loss idle", s.loaded_loss AS "Loss load", t.trace_loss AS "Loss trace",
  t.hops AS "Hops", t.routes AS "Routes", t.ecmp_width AS "ECMP",
  t.asn_path AS "AS path",
  GREATEST(s.last_seen, (SELECT created_at FROM iperf_traces WHERE id = t.last_trace)) AS "Last seen",
  COALESCE(s.c_id, t.c_id) AS c_id, COALESCE(s.p_id, t.p_id) AS p_id, t.last_trace
FROM s FULL JOIN t USING (c_id, p_id)
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = COALESCE(s.c_id, t.c_id)
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = COALESCE(s.p_id, t.p_id)
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: ↓ Download (receiver Mbps)
panels.description: Receiver-side average after the --omit slow-start window (v2 clients); v1 rows average the last 70 % of seconds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.created_at AS time, l.average_speed AS value, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS metric
FROM iperf_logs l
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at)
  AND l.test_type = 'download'
  AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ↑ Upload (receiver Mbps)
panels.description: Receiver-side average after the --omit slow-start window (v2 clients); v1 rows average the last 70 % of seconds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.created_at AS time, l.average_speed AS value, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS metric
FROM iperf_logs l
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at)
  AND l.test_type = 'upload'
  AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: RTT idle (ping avg)
panels.description: ICMP RTT measured before the bandwidth test (ICMP-only runs included).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.created_at AS time, (l.latency_idle->>'avg_ms')::numeric AS value, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS metric
FROM iperf_logs l
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at)
  AND l.test_type IN ('download', 'icmp')
  AND l.latency_idle->>'avg_ms' IS NOT NULL
  AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bufferbloat (loaded − idle RTT)
panels.description: How much the RTT grows while the link is saturated. < 30 ms is good, > 100 ms hurts games/calls.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.created_at AS time,
  (l.latency_loaded->>'avg_ms')::numeric - (l.latency_idle->>'avg_ms')::numeric AS value,
  COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || CASE l.test_type WHEN 'download' THEN ' ↓' ELSE ' ↑' END AS metric
FROM iperf_logs l
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at)
  AND l.test_type IN ('download', 'upload')
  AND l.latency_loaded->>'avg_ms' IS NOT NULL AND l.latency_idle->>'avg_ms' IS NOT NULL
  AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Jitter (mean |ΔRTT|)
panels.description: idle/load: ping during the idle phase and under load. trace: ttl ICMP probes to the destination.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, value, metric FROM (
  SELECT l.created_at AS time, (l.latency_idle->>'jitter_ms')::numeric AS value, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || ' idle' AS metric
  FROM iperf_logs l
  JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at) AND l.test_type IN ('download', 'icmp')
    AND l.latency_idle->>'jitter_ms' IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.created_at, (l.latency_loaded->>'jitter_ms')::numeric,
         COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || CASE l.test_type WHEN 'download' THEN ' load ↓' ELSE ' load ↑' END
  FROM iperf_logs l
  JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at) AND l.test_type IN ('download', 'upload')
    AND l.latency_loaded->>'jitter_ms' IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.created_at, t.dest_jitter_ms, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || ' trace'
  FROM iperf_traces t
  JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND t.dest_jitter_ms IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
) x
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Packet loss
panels.description: ICMP loss to the peer: idle ping, ping under load, and ttl probes (10 per run).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, value, metric FROM (
  SELECT l.created_at AS time, (l.latency_idle->>'loss_pct')::numeric AS value, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || ' idle' AS metric
  FROM iperf_logs l
  JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at) AND l.test_type IN ('download', 'icmp')
    AND l.latency_idle->>'loss_pct' IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.created_at, (l.latency_loaded->>'loss_pct')::numeric,
         COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || CASE l.test_type WHEN 'download' THEN ' load ↓' ELSE ' load ↑' END
  FROM iperf_logs l
  JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at) AND l.test_type IN ('download', 'upload')
    AND l.latency_loaded->>'loss_pct' IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.created_at, t.dest_loss_pct, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || ' trace'
  FROM iperf_traces t
  JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND t.dest_loss_pct IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
) x
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: TCP retransmits per second
panels.description: Sender-side retransmits / measured seconds. Rows without duration_sec (v1) assume 15 s.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.created_at AS time, l.retransmits::numeric / COALESCE(NULLIF(l.duration_sec, 0), 15) AS value,
  COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || CASE l.test_type WHEN 'download' THEN ' ↓' ELSE ' ↑' END AS metric
FROM iperf_logs l
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at)
  AND l.test_type IN ('download', 'upload') AND l.retransmits IS NOT NULL
  AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Destination RTT spread (ttl min / max)
panels.description: Lowest and highest of the 10 ttl ICMP probes per run. A growing gap = queueing/instability.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, value, metric FROM (
  SELECT t.created_at AS time, t.dest_min_ms AS value, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || ' min' AS metric
  FROM iperf_traces t JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND t.dest_min_ms IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.created_at, t.dest_max_ms, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) || ' max'
  FROM iperf_traces t JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND t.dest_max_ms IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
) x
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Route changes
panels.description: Route number per pair, in order of first appearance in the range (1 = the first route seen). A colour change = a router on the ICMP path changed. See the Traces table for the AS path.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT t.*, min(t.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY t.run_on_host_id, t.peer_host_id, t.path_hash) AS first_seen
  FROM iperf_traces t
  WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
)
SELECT t.created_at AS time, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS metric,
  dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY t.run_on_host_id, t.peer_host_id ORDER BY t.first_seen, t.path_hash)::text AS route
FROM t
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.created_at AS time, t.hop_count AS value, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS metric
FROM iperf_traces t
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND t.hop_count IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ECMP width (routers at the widest hop)
panels.description: From the multi-flow (UDP, 4 source ports) pass. 1 = single path.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.created_at AS time, t.ecmp_max_width AS value, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS metric
FROM iperf_traces t
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND t.ecmp_max_width IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where loss starts (TTL)
panels.description: First hop from which every later hop loses ≥ 5 % — real loss, not ICMP rate limiting on one router. Empty = no persistent loss.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.created_at AS time, t.loss_origin_ttl AS value, COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS metric
FROM iperf_traces t
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND t.loss_origin_ttl IS NOT NULL AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hops — trace ${trace_id}
panels.description: ICMP pass: loss/latency per hop. Loss on a single middle hop that does not carry on to later hops is ICMP rate limiting on that router, not real loss. ECMP/Alternative routers come from the multi-flow UDP pass.

targets.rawSql:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT ttl, count(*) AS n,
         string_agg(host(ip) || COALESCE(' ' || hostname, ''), ', ' ORDER BY received DESC) AS routers
  FROM iperf_trace_responders
  WHERE trace_id = ${trace_id} AND pass = 'ecmp'
  GROUP BY ttl
), o AS (
  SELECT r.ttl, string_agg(host(r.ip), ', ' ORDER BY r.received DESC) AS others
  FROM iperf_trace_responders r
  JOIN iperf_trace_hops h USING (trace_id, pass, ttl)
  WHERE r.trace_id = ${trace_id} AND r.pass = 'path' AND r.ip IS DISTINCT FROM h.primary_ip
  GROUP BY r.ttl
)
SELECT h.ttl AS "TTL",
  COALESCE(host(h.primary_ip), '*') AS "Router",
  r.hostname AS "Hostname",
  CASE WHEN r.asn IS NOT NULL THEN 'AS' || r.asn || ' ' || split_part(r.asn_name, ' - ', 1) END AS "AS",
  h.loss_pct AS "Loss",
  r.avg_ms AS "Avg", r.min_ms AS "Min", r.max_ms AS "Max", r.stddev_ms AS "StdDev", r.jitter_ms AS "Jitter",
  COALESCE(e.n, 0) AS "ECMP",
  concat_ws(' | ', o.others, CASE WHEN e.n > 1 THEN e.routers END) AS "Alternative routers"
FROM iperf_trace_hops h
LEFT JOIN iperf_trace_responders r
  ON r.trace_id = h.trace_id AND r.pass = h.pass AND r.ttl = h.ttl AND r.ip = h.primary_ip
LEFT JOIN e ON e.ttl = h.ttl
LEFT JOIN o ON o.ttl = h.ttl
WHERE h.trace_id = ${trace_id} AND h.pass = 'path'
ORDER BY h.ttl

panels.title: Latency by hop (stacked min → avg → max)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lpad(h.ttl::text, 2, '0') || ' ' || COALESCE(host(h.primary_ip), '*') AS hop,
  r.min_ms AS "min", r.avg_ms - r.min_ms AS "avg", r.max_ms - r.avg_ms AS "max"
FROM iperf_trace_hops h
LEFT JOIN iperf_trace_responders r
  ON r.trace_id = h.trace_id AND r.pass = h.pass AND r.ttl = h.ttl AND r.ip = h.primary_ip
WHERE h.trace_id = ${trace_id} AND h.pass = 'path'
ORDER BY h.ttl

panels.title: Traces
panels.description: Click a trace id to load its hops above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.id AS "Trace", t.created_at AS "Time", COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS "Pair",
  t.hop_count AS "Hops", t.reached AS "Reached", t.dest_loss_pct AS "Loss", t.dest_avg_ms AS "RTT",
  t.dest_jitter_ms AS "Jitter", t.ecmp_hops AS "ECMP hops", t.ecmp_max_width AS "ECMP width",
  t.path_hash IS DISTINCT FROM lag(t.path_hash) OVER (PARTITION BY t.run_on_host_id, t.peer_host_id ORDER BY t.created_at)
    AS "Route changed",
  t.asn_path AS "AS path", t.bind_interface AS "Iface"
FROM iperf_traces t
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = t.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = t.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) AND ('0' IN ($client) OR t.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR t.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
LIMIT 300

SELECT l.id AS "ID", l.created_at AS "Time", COALESCE(c.alias, c.host) || ' ↔ ' || COALESCE(p.alias, p.host) AS "Pair", l.test_type AS "Type",
  l.average_speed AS "Mbps", l.bind_interface AS "Iface", l.streams AS "Streams",
  (l.latency_idle->>'avg_ms')::numeric AS "RTT idle", (l.latency_loaded->>'avg_ms')::numeric AS "RTT load",
  (l.latency_loaded->>'jitter_ms')::numeric AS "Jitter load",
  (l.latency_loaded->>'loss_pct')::numeric AS "Loss load", l.retransmits AS "Retr",
  (SELECT max(t.id) FROM iperf_traces t WHERE t.run_id = l.run_id) AS "Trace"
FROM iperf_logs l
JOIN iperf_hosts c ON c.id = l.run_on_host_id
JOIN iperf_hosts p ON p.id = l.peer_host_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(l.created_at) AND l.test_type <> 'icmp' AND ('0' IN ($client) OR l.run_on_host_id IN ($client))
  AND ('0' IN ($peer) OR l.peer_host_id IN ($peer))
ORDER BY l.id DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT (series.ordinality)::int AS second, (series.value)::numeric AS speed
FROM iperf_logs l
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(l.second_measurements->'data') WITH ORDINALITY AS series(value, ordinality)
WHERE l.id = ${test_id}
ORDER BY second
